# Presets: Comfort (4 templates)

### 1. Morning Playlist — Climate turns on in AM → Media Toggle Play
### 2. Volume Normalize — Drive starts → Set Volume to 5
### 3. Kids Mode — Enter school zone geofence → Speed Limit 25 MPH + Volume Down
### 4. Quiet Hours — Daily 10 PM → Volume Down

## Implementation
Store in `internal/automation/presets/comfort.go`.
